name: Bintulu Port Holdings Berhad
summary: Bintulu Port Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, operates in port operator business in Malaysia and Brunei. It operates through two segments: Port Operations and Bulking Services. The company engages in construction of port facilities; and handling cargo for liquefied natural gas, petroleum products, liquefied petroleum gas, general cargo, container, dry bulk cargo, and other ancillary services. It also exports liquefied natural gas.
